atoms.text: Class 3A voted between Jade and Trisha to represent them on the school council.

instruction.text: 8 pupils voted for Jade. Select the correct number of squares on the bar chart to show how many votes Jade got.
5 pupils voted for Trisha. Select the correct number of squares to complete the bar chart.

atoms.text: Class 3A also voted on which game to play at break time.

instruction.text: 3 pupils voted for football. Select the correct number of squares to fill in the football bar.
8 pupils voted for benchball. Select the correct number of squares to complete the bar chart.
